functionDeclarations.name: list_plugin_accounts
functionDeclarations.description: List the accounts the user has connected for installed plugins: each plugin's auth providers, their sign-in status, the identity signed in as, and the CLIs they power. Use this to check whether the user is signed in before running a plugin CLI, and to tell the user exactly which provider to reconnect in the Plugins Manager when authentication fails. When a provider has multiple accounts connected, select one for a sandboxed CLI command by prefixing the command with AGY_ACCOUNT=<account> (an account name from this tool's output); without the prefix, the default account is used.
